name: duopore-public-daily-checkin-summary
description: See what you finished today, what is left and how much time you recorded.

interface.longDescription: See what you finished today, what is left and how much time you recorded. Enter your targets, actual counts and minutes by activity. Get a plain summary of progress, gaps and extra work. For adults checking their own activity. It uses only the updates you share; it does not monitor you, guess progress or judge your motivation.
defaultPrompt: Summarize today's progress from these targets and actual counts.
What is left from my daily plan based on my check-in?

positive.prompt: Use Daily Check-in Summary with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"date":"2026-10-04","activities":[{"activity":"Practice questions","unit":"questions","targetCount":10,"actualCount":6,"actualMinutes":25,"nextStep":"Review the four remaining questions tomorrow."},{"activity":"File notes","unit":"folders","targetCount":2,"actualCount":2,"actualMinutes":10,"nextStep":"None"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 of 2 activities met their supplied count targets; 35 minutes recorded.","rows":[{"date":"2026-10-04","activity":"Practice questions","unit":"questions","targetCount":10,"actualCount":6,"remainingCount":4,"extraCount":0,"targetCompletionPercent":60,"actualMinutes":25,"nextStep":"Review the four remaining questions tomorrow."},{"date":"2026-10-04","activity":"File notes","unit":"folders","targetCount":2,"actualCount":2,"remainingCount":0,"extraCount":0,"targetCompletionPercent":100,"actualMinutes":10,"nextStep":"None"}],"warnings":["Only entered facts are summarized. Different count units are not added together; no motivation, health or future performance is inferred."]}

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.

publication.release_notes: Clear benefit-first descriptions and original bold geometric branding with light/dark icon variants. App behavior, privacy, connections and review evidence unchanged.
